senses.gloss: f. (גפף) a pressed hard mass, peat, turf.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 47b:11">Ib. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ של זתים</he> peat made of olive peels, <he>דשומשמין</he> of poppy seed (after the oil is pressed out).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 9:5">Kel. IX, 5</cite>; a. fr.—Ch. <cite ref="C00799"><he>גִּיפְתָּא</he></cite>.
